sections.title: Property Sheets (§30G)
sections.md:
**PROP-B — Bernadette's house**

| # | Field | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Type and era | 1890s Victorian red-brick terrace in Birmingham, lived in for decades, a little dated |
| 2 | Shell | faded cream embossed wallpaper painted over · tall gloss-white moulded skirting, chipped · moulded white architraves · dark-stained four-panel doors, round wooden knobs · white ceiling, ornate ceiling rose, fabric shade · red/cream/black encaustic tiles in the hall, deep green patterned stair carpet with brass rods, coir mat · white column radiator under a shelf · white plastic switches |
| 3 | Floor map | front door → hall; one straight flight rises away from the door along the **right-hand** wall; the front room through the doorway on the **left**; the hall dresser on the left-hand wall |
| 4 | Orientation | the front (stained-glass door panel) faces **east**: bright in the morning |
| 5 | Carried elements | the oak hall dresser with two drawers and its mirror · the green stair carpet · the telephone table with the lace runner · the camel coat on the hooks · the harbour print |
| 6 | Exterior | red-brick terrace fronts, a small tiled front path |
| 7 | Standing negatives | none yet (first plate) |

**PROP-S — Sian's house**

| # | Field | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Type and era | 1900s stone miner's cottage in a Welsh valleys terrace, plain and warm |
| 2 | Shell | chalky white uneven plaster · plain soft-grey square skirting and architraves · ledged-and-braced pine doors, black iron thumb latches · low white ceiling, paper pendant shade · grey slate flagstones in the passage, bare varnished pine stair treads, rag rug · narrow white panel radiator · white plastic switches |
| 3 | Floor map | front door → passage; a steep straight flight rises away along the **left-hand** wall with a wall-fixed rail; the kitchen through the doorway on the **right**, at the back |
| 4 | Orientation | the front faces **west**; the kitchen window and back yard face east onto the hillside; late morning the stair-top window is the bright source |
| 5 | Carried elements | the steep bare-tread stairs and wall rail · the iron coat pegs with the purple waterproof and dog lead · the muddy boots on the rag rug · the pine kitchen table, the calendar by the back door, the dog bed |
| 6 | Exterior | stone terrace on a hillside, sheep fields above the roofs |
| 7 | Standing negatives | none yet (first plate) |

Gordon's house appears only in the kitchen, so it needs no property plate.

**Light arc (Mode 1, daylight only):** the hooks are the only "before" light — Gordon's and Sian's kitchens flat and grey, Bernadette's drawer in the morning hall. From the strap on (HK-BR onwards) it's the after: sun in the room, windows bright, outdoors in sun. Never dark, never moody (§12).
